summary:
Mangal Health Sentinel (VITALIS ORBIT) is a 100% offline edge-computing medical avionics and astronaut health monitoring platform developed by Team Mission Mangal 2.0 for crewed interplanetary missions like the 180-day Mars transit. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Three.js, it solves the critical challenge of severe communication latency and deep-space signal blackouts.

The platform addresses interplanetary health hazards by providing autonomous physiological tracking (combatting SANS, bone density loss, and cardiac atrophy), interactive 3D anatomical and module mapping, deterministic AI inventory substitution for medical shortages, and military-grade Web Crypto security featuring an emergency "Break-Glass" override.

This project is vital because it bridges terrestrial healthcare software with flight-deck avionics, ensuring that astronauts maintain self-sufficient, highly secure, and proactive medical oversight without relying on real-time intervention from Earth.
details: Mission-Mangal-2.0 (Mangal Health Sentinel / VITALIS ORBIT) is a 100% offline edge-computing medical avionics and astronaut health monitoring platform engineered for crewed interplanetary missions like the 180-day Mars transit. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Three.js, it delivers autonomous physiological tracking to combat microgravity hazards like SANS and bone loss, interactive 3D anatomical and module mapping, deterministic AI inventory substitution for medical shortages, and Web Crypto (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM) security with a secure "Break-Glass" emergency override. By operating entirely locally without relying on Earth communication during deep-space signal blackouts, the platform bridges terrestrial healthcare software with flight-deck avionics to ensure maximum crew safety and mission resilience.
